product_overview: M.E Education System is a cloud-based school and coaching management web app for multi-campus institutions. It centralizes authentication, administrative setup, student and staff management, academics, and portal dashboards in a role-based interface.
core_goals: Sign in and reach the appropriate role-based dashboard
Manage users, campuses, roles, and academic structure across campuses
View and maintain operational data for students, staff, and academics

features.name: Global Authentication Flow
features.description: Allows users to sign in and be routed to the correct portal based on their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit sign-in form -> See the role-based dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit sign-in form -> See an error message

features.name: Staff HR Directory Management
features.description: Lets authorized staff view, add, edit, delete, and bulk import staff and admin users.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/users -> View the paginated user directory -> Open the add-user flow -> Enter user details -> Submit the form -> See the new user in the list
Navigate to /admin/users -> Open the bulk import flow -> Upload a CSV file -> Submit the import -> See imported users reflected in the directory
Navigate to /admin/users -> Select a user row -> Open the edit flow -> Update user details -> Save changes -> See the updated record in the table

features.name: Multi-Campus Management
features.description: Supports viewing and maintaining campus records for the institution.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/campuses -> View the campus list -> Open the campus creation flow -> Enter campus name, code, and address -> Save the campus -> See it added to the list
Navigate to /admin/campuses -> View the campus list -> Toggle a campus active state -> See the campus status change in the list

features.name: Academic Hierarchy Configuration
features.description: Allows authorized users to manage academic structure through classes, sections, and subjects.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/academics -> Switch between Classes, Sections, and Subjects tabs -> View the configured academic hierarchy
Navigate to /admin/academics -> Open the class creation flow -> Enter class details -> Save the class -> See the new class in the list
Navigate to /admin/academics -> Open the section creation flow -> Choose a class -> Enter section details -> Save the section -> See the new section linked to the selected class
